name: Misty Valley
summary: Fog gathers in Misty Valley, north of the pass into Deadwind. Swamp beasts and marsh horrors roam its secluded basin in the northwestern Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: A Fog-Shrouded Glen
sections.body: Cliffs rise between the Swamp of Sorrows and Deadwind Pass, and fog shrouds the hollow below. Colossal marsh elementals crowd this isolated valley. Swampwalkers and ancient swampwalker elders roam among creeping tangled horrors. At the gorge’s far end, a cavern shelters one of the bog’s strongest natural threats: the Mire Lord.

faq.q: Where is the Misty Valley located?
faq.answer: Misty Valley lies in the far northwestern Swamp of Sorrows, directly north of the road into Deadwind Pass.
Swampwalkers, elder swampwalkers, and tangled horrors roam the fog.

faq.q: What is inside the cave at the back of the valley?
aliases: who is in misty valley cave
faq.answer: The Mire Lord dwells deep inside the cave at Misty Valley’s rear. This massive, powerful marsh elemental reigns over the secluded hollow.

faq.q: Is the Misty Valley safe to traverse?
faq.answer: Misty Valley is dangerous to cross. Towering swampwalkers and tangled horrors roam its dense fog, hostile to travelers who leave the main road.

angles.text: As a druid, you see swampwalkers and tangled horrors as the wild fury of marsh elementals, bound to the swamp’s primordial nature.
